subject.title: fix: keep inbound metadata in runtime context

question: Should maintainers land this focused clean-prompt runtime-context fix as the canonical path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72704, fold it into the newer tail-carrier cache-stability work, or wait for the broader reply-metadata contract?
rationale: The branch is a valid focused fix, but live related work now changes carrier placement and reply metadata semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent owner boundary or landing order.

options.title: Refresh This Focused Fix
options.body: Resolve conflicts against current main, preserve the merged prompt-boundary logic from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95349, and land this PR as the narrow fix for inline inbound metadata.

options.title: Fold Into Tail Carrier Work
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100272 as the canonical path if maintainers want the prompt-cache byte-stability fix to land with the runtime-context handoff.

options.title: Wait For Reply Contract
options.body: Defer this PR until the broader reply-metadata contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 is chosen.

recommendation.title: Refresh This Focused Fix
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts against current main, preserve the merged prompt-boundary logic from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95349, and land this PR as the narrow fix for inline inbound metadata.
